  • Method Details

    • pickCard

      public void pickCard(Game game, String nickname, String row, int cardIndex) throws Exception
      Executes the drawing of a card by the current player. Verifies turn, availability of picks on the tile (or any Extra Pick on the upper row), validity of row/index and cost coverage; then consumes the pick, removes the card from the board, applies its logic and notifies the clients. If the picks are exhausted, automatically ends the turn.
      Overrides:
      pickCard in class GameState
      Parameters:
      game - the current game
      nickname - the player who is picking
      row - the chosen row ("upper" or "lower")
      cardIndex - the index of the card (characters followed by buildings)
      Throws:
      Exception - if it's not their turn, the move is invalid or they can't afford the card

    • endTurn

      public void endTurn(Game game, String nickname) throws Exception
      Voluntarily ends the player's picking turn. Not allowed if there are mandatory picks left with available characters (except for the development nicknames "tester"/"tester2"). In case of unused Extra Pick, consumes it.
      Overrides:
      endTurn in class GameState
      Parameters:
      game - the current game
      nickname - the player ending the turn
      Throws:
      Exception - if it's not their turn or there are residual mandatory picks

    • skipTurn

      public void skipTurn(Game game, String nickname) throws Exception
      Skips the picking turn of the current player (e.g. disconnected): closes their pick returning the totem, applies the end-of-turn building effects and advances the phase (next picker, or transition to Event/EndGame if picking is complete).
      Overrides:
      skipTurn in class GameState
      Parameters:
      game - the current game
      nickname - the player to skip
      Throws:
      Exception - if it's not their turn

    • handleDisconnection

      public void handleDisconnection(Game game, Player p, boolean isCurrentPlayer) throws Exception
      Handles the disconnection of a NON-turn player who had an occupied tile: frees it, moves them to the bottom of the turn order and notifies the totem return (the turn player continues picking undisturbed).
      Overrides:
      handleDisconnection in class GameState
      Parameters:
      game - the current game
      p - the disconnected player
      isCurrentPlayer - true if they were the turn player
      Throws:
      Exception - in case of error
